items.question: What is the best size for a YouTube thumbnail?
items.answer: The ideal size is 1280x720 pixels (with a minimum width of 640 pixels). Lovart automatically generates images in the correct 16:9 aspect ratio optimized for YouTube's requirements.

items.question: Can I put my own face in the AI thumbnail?
items.answer: Yes! Use the 'Reference Image' or 'Face Swap' features. Upload a selfie, and the AI can place you into any scenario while maintaining your likeness, or simply enhance your existing photo.

items.question: Does text on thumbnails really help CTR?
items.answer: Data shows that thumbnails with concise, punchy text (usually under 5 words) perform better. Lovart's Design Agent is trained to suggest text that complements the visual without cluttering it.

items.question: Can I create thumbnails for Shorts?
items.answer: Absolutely. While Shorts thumbnails are less prominent, having a good cover is crucial for the channel page. Lovart allows you to switch to a 9:16 aspect ratio instantly.

items.question: Is it copyright safe?
items.answer: Yes, all images generated by Lovart are unique and royalty-free. You own the commercial rights to the thumbnails you create, so you don't have to worry about copyright strikes.
